description: Advisory mapping from skill name to the SDLC phases in which it is intended to run. Consumed by skill self-checks and documentation. Hook-level path enforcement lives separately in hooks/scripts/phase-policy.json.

onboard.description: Project bootstrap (renamed from init in v2.19.0) — runs exactly once at the start of REQUIREMENTS.

prd-quality-analyzer.description: Scores PRD testability and surfaces ambiguity; only meaningful before DESIGN.

brownfield-intake.description: Sprint 39. The brownfield on-ramp: after onboard on an existing codebase, fingerprints the repo (codebase-intel) and asks how to define the increment (describe / doc / guided Q&A / GitHub-GitLab issue), then synthesizes a code-anchored, increment-scoped requirements doc for prd-quality-analyzer.

design-bootstrap.description: Sprint 34. The DESIGN-phase guide: asks the operator for a design source (Claude-native / existing Figma via design-bridge / from-scratch via the official Figma MCP), produces design/ artifacts (spec + tokens + wireframes), and arms the DESIGN consensus marker.

architecture-bootstrap.description: Sprint 37. The ARCHITECTURE-phase author-side guide (counterpart to design-bootstrap): asks the operator the technology baseline, then authors docs/architecture.md + ADRs (domain-policy-aware security architecture) and arms the consensus marker. architecture-validator then validates it.

business-rule-validator.description: Extracts and validates business rules; depends on approved PRD.

architecture-validator.description: Validates proposed architecture against domain policies and invariants.

test-strategy-planner.description: Produces scenario-set.md and test-strategy.md from the PRD.

mobile-stability-runner.description: Sprint 45. Mobile crash & stability testing (iOS/Android, Expo-aware: Expo→Maestro / bare→Detox): cold-start smoke + crash-prone scenario battery (background/foreground, low-memory, deep links, permission denial, network loss, rotation) + native-crash/redbox/ANR detection + crash-reporter surfacing. Platform-conditional lane of the phase-runner TESTING walk; graceful-degrades when no device is available.

regression-test-runner.description: Runs the test suite and computes pass rate.

mutation-test-runner.description: Generates mutations and computes mutation score.

coverage-analyzer.description: Rolls up coverage to requirement level; enforces P0 zero-uncovered rule.

input-validation-matrix.description: Sprint 44. Per-field UI data-validation matrix (required/type/boundary/format/type-mismatch/injection-safety/output-formatting); writes runnable tests into the suite + validation-matrix.md. Part of the UI-conditional front-end battery the phase-runner TESTING walk orchestrates.

frontend-render-check.description: Sprint 53 (Sprint 67: also DEVELOPMENT render-as-you-build). Actually boots a web UI (JS dev server with mocks, or — Sprint 66 — the real server for a server-rendered app), captures + surfaces hero-screen screenshots, and compares them to the design (Figma via design-bridge db_compare_impl, else the design-spec mockups + tokens). Ends the 'dark tunnel' where a UI ships unit-tested but never rendered or compared to the design; catches won't-boot bugs and design divergence. In DEVELOPMENT phase-runner runs it on the screens the increment changed (render-as-you-build, proportionate gate: BLOCKED stops, drift surfaces; never arms the consensus marker — that's TESTING). First lane of the UI-conditional front-end battery in TESTING.

integration-verifier.description: Sprint 58. For a full-stack increment, proves the front-end actually talks to a REAL back-end end-to-end with seeded test data, locally (no deployed staging required): boots the back-end, seeds deterministic data via test-data-manager, points the real front-end at the local back-end instead of mocks, and drives the SCN-UI-*-DATA-* data-binding scenarios (populated/loading/empty/error/offline). The middle integration rung between frontend-render-check (mocks — looks right) and uat-executor (deployed staging). Gated on integration-wiring-check.sh = wired/unwired; single-tier/no-app increments skip it. BLOCKs when the back-end won't boot, an endpoint 404s, or the UI errors on real data — the 'mock front-end over a claimed backend' trap.

cross-run-consistency.description: Runs the same test N times to detect flake.

observability-analyzer.description: Parses HAR, console logs; detects anomalies. Read-only.

release-decision-engine.description: Aggregates all quality signals into GO/CONDITIONAL/BLOCKED.

learning-loop-engine.description: Consumes historical reports to detect patterns. Read-only. Four modes: test-history / production-feedback / drift-analysis run at DEPLOYMENT (release + retrospective pipelines); the Sprint 20-B/C consensus-history mode mines .vibeflow/state/consensus/history.jsonl for slow-converging phases, reviewer skew, recurring suggestion themes, convergence stalls, and the arbiter-decision effectiveness trace — runnable at any phase boundary. Writes .vibeflow/reports/consensus-learning-report.md in consensus-history mode.

consensus-orchestrator.description: Multi-AI review; can run at any point on any artifact.

consensus-arbiter.description: Reads a consensus session's reviewer suggestions and emits diff-first patches — never writes to source directly (Sprint 15-F).

apply-arbiter-patch.description: Operator-in-the-loop patch applicator. Shows diff preview, asks for confirmation, applies via `git apply`, optional --run-tests (Sprint 15-G). Doc-only patches pass through the phase-write-guard in earlier phases.

consensus-specialist.description: Sprint 17-E dispatcher. Reads currentPhase and forks the matching phase-specialist agent (prd-rewriter/design-spec-refiner/adr-author/test-strategy-refiner/coverage-gap-filler/runbook-editor) to produce one deep-rewrite diff-first patch. Offered alongside consensus-arbiter from the orchestrator's NEEDS_REVISION / HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED follow-up.

learning-apply.description: Sprint 22 'close the action gap'. Reads .vibeflow/reports/consensus-learning-report.md and turns recommendations into action via three lanes: config-tune (diff-first patch to vibeflow.config.json under .vibeflow/state/patches/learning-<ts>/, applied only with --yes after EngineConfigSchema re-validation + bounds clamp), template-route (recommends the matching phase specialist via consensus-specialist — does not auto-fork), escalate (hands to decision-recommender). Propose-only / diff-first — NEVER writes config or source directly. Bounded by learningApply.{enabled, maxRelativeStep, minObservations}.

phase-runner.description: Sprint 19-F end-to-end phase orchestrator. Runs the current phase's analyzer(s) → consensus-orchestrator on primaryArtifact → specialist/arbiter → apply-arbiter-patch (auto-chain) → sdlc_advance_phase. Bounded by phaseRunner.{autoAdvance, maxConvergenceAttempts}. Uses the S19-A marker schema v2 so reviewers see the primary artifact with analyzer reports as context.

flow-status.description: Reports current phase and pending work. Read-only. Renamed from `status` in v2.20.0 (avoids the built-in /status collision).

advance.description: Sprint 17.1 wrapper around sdlc_advance_phase MCP tool. Validates target phase, parses optional humanOverrideNote for HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED advances, surfaces exit-criterion failures with remediation suggestions.

quality-gates.description: Sprint 18-F. Runs lint + typecheck + unit-tests from vibeflow.config.json.tech.* and auto-satisfies `quality.gates.passed`. Pairs with consensus-orchestrator (which satisfies `code.reviewed` on APPROVED commit review) to unblock DEVELOPMENT → TESTING advance without manual MCP calls.

deploy-verifier.description: Sprint 18-G. Post-deployment smoke test: CI pipeline status (dev-ops MCP) + endpoint curl + observability health dashboard. Auto-satisfies `deployment.verified` + `health.checks.passed`. Writes the consensus-needed marker so `consensus.deployment.approved` still flows through multi-AI review.

loop-status.description: Sprint 30-B. The autonomous-loop dashboard: runs loop-audit.sh and consolidates phase-runner progress + auto-apply outcomes/revert-rates + cooldowns + armed watch + learning findings + cross-project signal into one view; writes .vibeflow/reports/loop-status.md. Read-only.

product-bible.description: Sprint 68. The Product Bible foundation: runs bible-status.sh to cross-reference the doc taxonomy (hooks/scripts/bible-manifest.json) against the repo and report which canonical lifecycle docs (vision/personas/glossary/domain-model/ADRs/PRD/test-strategy/roadmap/GTM…) are present vs missing — VibeFlow-produced docs referenced in place, never duplicated; scaffolds docs/product-bible/ with templated stubs for missing bible-native docs. Read-mostly (only writes the scaffold).

streams.description: Sprint 60. The parallel team-work dashboard: runs streams-audit.sh and consolidates every locally-visible work-stream (branch + SDLC phase + cycle status + engine revision) into one view, flags shared-branch conflicts; writes .vibeflow/reports/streams.md. Read-only. Meaningful when streams.enabled is on (per-branch isolated SDLC state).

integrate.description: Sprint 60. The merge point for parallel work-streams: on an integration/release branch, opens an integration cycle (sdlc_start_cycle), runs integration-verifier over the combined front↔back surface + cross-feature consensus, so independently-developed features reconcile in code + one integration gate before ship.

traceability-engine.description: Maps requirements to test scenarios and source code.

arch-guardrails.description: Validates changes against architectural rules before commit.

checklist-generator.description: Emits review checklists (PR, release, feature sign-off).
